newsitem.title: USA: Cyclone could bring heavy rain to Queensland - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Cyclone could bring heavy rain to Queensland - WSC.

text.p: Tropical Cyclone Justin is approaching the coast of Queensland, Australia, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Friday.
The cyclone is about 200 miles northeast of Cairns, moving west-southwest at eight mph and with top winds of 50 mph.

Landfall is expected near Cairns in about 24 hours, when top winds should be near 40 mph and the storm will be dissipating, WSC said. It may produce rain heavy enough for flash flooding but winds should not be a major problem.
Justin could bring heavy rains to cane areas and locally heavy rains to northern cotton areas this weekend.
